native_title: あんたじゃなくて、その唇
description:
She looks like an ordinary female college student, but she can taste the other person's feelings with a kiss.

white! Unlike her ability to be romantic, Sohee is known for her strange (?) tastes... Nonsense! What is this sweet taste!! Who are you? My fateful mate?!

I end up not believing in love. Then one day, on a drunken night where I lost my memory, I ended up kissing someone.
